		echo "⚠️  AI testing framework not available"; \
	}
echo "✅ Mobile PlantGuard ready!"
echo "📱 Launching Mobile PlantGuard Application"
if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then \
		echo "⚠️  Environment not ready. Running setup..."; \
		make setup-environment || { \
			echo "❌ Environment setup failed"; \
			echo "💡 Try: make setup-environment"; \
			exit 1; \
		}; \
	fi
echo "🔗 Mobile Application will be available at: http://localhost:8502"
echo "📱 Mobile-first design optimized for Chrome & Safari Mobile"
echo "✨ Features: Touch-friendly UI, Fixed 428px layout, AI agent testing"
echo "🎯 Fixed Design: Always 428px width (mobile-first on all screens)"
echo "💻 Desktop View: Shows mobile interface in 428px column"
if [ 1 -eq 1 ]; then \
		echo "🚀 Apple Silicon MPS acceleration enabled"; \
		export PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK=1; \
	fi
echo "🤖 Built-in AI Agent autonomous testing and self-healing"
echo "🔍 Checking port availability..."
if lsof -Pi :8502 -sTCP:LISTEN -t >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
		echo "⚠️  Port 8502 is already in use"; \
		echo "💡 Stopping existing process..."; \
		lsof -ti:8502 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; \
		sleep 2; \
	fi
echo "🚀 Starting Mobile PlantGuard..."
.venv/bin/python -m streamlit run mobile_spa_app.py \
		--server.port 8502 \
		--server.headless true \
		--server.enableCORS false \
		--server.enableXsrfProtection false \
		--server.maxUploadSize 200 \
		--theme.base light || { \
		echo "❌ Failed to start Mobile PlantGuard"; \
		echo "💡 Check logs above for errors"; \
		echo "💡 Try: make validate-mobile"; \
		exit 1; \
	}
